opening_line: Launching Leanne Digital in 2023 to put beautiful design and real strategy in the same room, after years in agency and in-house roles, shows in how your projects are scoped. Which side do clients usually walk in asking for?

Marketers who can't tell a hanging weight from a hot weight, handing ranchers plans built for software companies, is a very specific reason to start an agency. Do butchers notice the difference on the first call?

Team pages still listing retired employees and a news section frozen in the 2010s are painfully specific tells for environmental consulting sites. Do those firms usually spot it themselves, or does a lost bid tell them?

Rebuilding your design business in Richmond while doing QuickBooks work for equestrian businesses on the side is not a path many studio owners share. Does that bookkeeping eye still show up when you scope a project?

The attorney bio template you describe, photo, education, bar admissions, two paragraphs of advocacy and a contact button, is what almost every firm site runs on. Do Georgia firms let you redesign those pages, or only rewrite them?
